headline: Registered Nurse (Enfermeiro/a) | Medical-Surgical Inpatient Specialist | 5+ Years Acute Hospital Experience
summary: Dedicated Registered Nurse with over 5 years of progressive clinical experience in high-acuity medical-surgical inpatient wards and emergency care across major hospital units in the Lisbon metropolitan area. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Nursing (Licenciatura em Enfermagem) and a Postgraduate Specialization in Medical-Surgical Nursing, alongside an active license with the Ordem dos Enfermeiros. Proven track record in managing complex post-operative patients, spearheading clinical safety protocols that reduced ward medication errors by 22%, and mentoring junior nursing staff. Proficient in both Glintt and SClínico electronic health record systems.

experience.title: Senior Inpatient Registered Nurse - Medical-Surgical Unit
bullets: Deliver comprehensive, patient-centred nursing care in a 36-bed Medical-Surgical inpatient ward, managing an average caseload of 6 to 8 acute post-operative and internal medicine patients per shift.
Serve as Shift Coordinator (Enfermeiro Chefe de Equipa) for a multidisciplinary team of 7 nurses and 4 healthcare assistants, overseeing bed allocation, clinical handovers, and emergency escalations.

Led the implementation of a double-check protocol for high-alert intravenous medications using the Glintt HS electronic health record system, reducing administration errors on the ward by 22% over 12 months.
Precepted and evaluated 9 newly hired nurses and final-year nursing students, standardizing onboarding procedures for complex wound care and central venous catheter maintenance.

Collaborate daily with surgeons, internists, and physiotherapists to execute individualized early-mobilization plans, contributing to a 15% reduction in average length of stay for orthopaedic and abdominal surgery patients.

experience.title: Registered Nurse - Acute Medicine & Surgical Inpatient Ward
bullets: Provided direct clinical care in a fast-paced 42-bed acute inpatient unit, performing continuous vital signs monitoring, complex surgical dressing changes, pain management, and blood transfusions.
Documented nursing assessments, care plans (CIPE/ICNP taxonomy), and clinical interventions accurately in SClínico, ensuring 100% compliance during internal quality audits.
Acted as the ward's Infection Control Link Nurse (Elo de Ligação PPCIRA), conducting monthly hand-hygiene audits that helped decrease catheter-associated urinary tract infections by 18% in 2020.
Rapidly identified clinical deterioration using the NEWS2 scoring system and initiated Advanced Life Support protocols alongside the internal medical emergency team.
